title: Shahedeen ye ab farmaaye
body:
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
KOUN HEIN MERI MADAD KO AAYE
AOUN-O-MOHAMMED DONO SIDHARE
SATH NAHI ZAINAB KEY DULHARE
ZULM ANOKHEY DEKHEY KOI NA
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
PAL KI DULHAN AB BEWA BANI HEIN
ZAINAB DUKHIYA KOOK JALI HEIN
CHAYA HAI GHANGOOR ANDHERA
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
JEENE KEY AASAR NAHI HEIN
MONISO GHAMKHAAR NAHI HEIN
LAASHE JAWAN AB KOUN UTHAYE
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
MASHAK-E-SAKINA SATH RAHEGI
AASHKAO KI BARSATH RAHEGI
KOUN HAI SHAH KO AJ SAMBHALE
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
SHAAME GHAREEBA BUM MEIN AYI
DUKHIYAO PAR MEHSHAR KO LAAYI
AASI BASTI KOI LUTI NA
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAINAB KE AB DIL SE PUCHO
GUZRI KYA HEIN UN PAR SOUNCHO
AASHK LAHU KEY BUN MEIN BAHAYE
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
MASHK-O-ALAM KO THAME HUE HEIN
SHANE KATA-E-GHAZI GAYE HEIN
ZULM NIRALE DEKHEY KOI NA
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
KHETE HEIN IQBAL YEH ROKAR
HAYE RAHE NA QASIM-O-AKBER
GHAZI KEY PARCHAM KO UTHAYE
<<MINI>>
SHAH-E-DEEN YE AB FARMAYE
